environment.description: Service deployed in an Alpine-based container where the entrypoint script invokes pivot_root(2) into /srv/app after bind-mounting only the application code directory. The process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS. The container's OCI runtime spec sets rootfs to a read-only overlay with an explicit maskedPaths list covering /proc/self/environ, /proc/self/mountinfo, and /sys. The filesystem namespace visible to the process contains only: /srv/app/{main.py,requirements.txt}, /usr/lib/python3.11/**, /tmp (noexec,nosuid tmpfs). No /etc/app directory exists in the chroot, no /proc/self/environ is readable, and path traversal via '../' resolves within the pivot_root boundary. The container also has a seccomp profile that blocks open_by_handle_at(2) preventing escape from the namespace.
